messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: billing-ingest consumer lag exceeded threshold (sev: high)
pagerduty-service: Incident PD-2026-778 opened — "billing-ingest consumer lag > 3h"
pagerduty-service: Pager: maya
maya: ack'd in PD. oncall checking. tagging @sam for infra
sam: looking at consumer lag graphs, consumer group "billing-ingest-cg" showing ~1800000 messages behind, tailing since 03:40 UTC
jamie: finance has flagged two customer support tickets: invoices delayed for customers 1001 and 1007. they report missing usage rows in ledger view
lee: finance: please pause auto-billing for any accounts with >12h missing rows. we'll need final counts before we invoice
maya: quick symptom summary:
- consumer pod crashloop + GC/OOM errors
- offset commit failures causing checkpoint regression
- duplication noise in token counts for a small subset
sam: checking pods:
```
kubectl get sts -n billing | grep consumer
billing-consumer-0   0/1 CrashLoopBackOff  10m
billing-consumer-1   1/1 Running          2d
```
sam: logs from consumer-0: repeated java.lang.OutOfMemoryError and OffsetCommitFailedException, GC pause logs
maya: probable cause: heap pressure during rebalance -> commit failures
sam: mitigation options: restart pod with higher heap, or drain and scale consumers to allow stable rebalance. i'm going to bump HEAP_TARGET=4g and do a rolling restart
sam: commands:
```
kubectl set env sts/billing-consumer HEAP_TARGET=4g -n billing
kubectl rollout restart sts/billing-consumer -n billing
```
maya: please proceed. i'll monitor offsets and token_count deltas. tagging @jamie @lee
incident-bot: action logged: rollout restart initiated by sam at 2026-06-04T03:55:12Z
sam: rollout done, consumer-0 stable 1/1 running. consumer group rebalanced. observing lag drop from ~3.5h -> ~22m over 8 minutes
jamie: ran reconciliation query against ledger: 9/11 affected accounts still show mismatches; many duplicates appear to have been written during the commit failures
maya: recommended immediate steps: 1) schedule idempotent reprocess for impacted accounts, 2) hold auto-invoices for those accounts until reconciliation completes
sam: launching reprocess job for customer list via tools/reprocess_tokens.py
sam: ```
python tools/reprocess_tokens.py --customers 1001,1007,1012,1015 --max-rows 5000
```
incident-bot: reprocess job queued (job-9901)
maya: customer impact: invoices delayed up to 8 hours for ~11 customers; potential incorrect billed token counts for ~6 customers. Severity: high (customer-impacting, limited scope)
lee: finance: auto-billing paused for flagged customers. will await jamie's reconciliation report before unpausing
jamie: reprocess complete for most customers; 2 accounts still show ~150 token deficit. investigating raw event stream for missing events vs duplicate suppress
sam: found a broker network flapping event during rebalance window, opening infra ticket BRK-789 for broker cluster zeta
sam: BRK-789: broker zeta experienced brief disconnects causing duplicate processing windows
maya: good catch. owners and action items:
- sam: follow BRK-789 and confirm remediation/monitoring (owner: sam)
- jamie: finish reconciliation and propose manual invoice adjustments if needed (owner: jamie)
- lee: maintain invoice holds until reconciliation clear (owner: lee)
- maya: draft postmortem and link telemetry + runbook gaps (owner: maya)
pagerduty-service: Incident PD-2026-778 status changed to mitigated -> monitoring (acknowledged by maya and sam)
maya: handing off to sam for overnight watch. next oncall alex will be paged if lag resurfaces. i'll update the incident doc and timeline
sam: monitoring dashboards up, increased retention for ingest metrics. will escalate if lag > 1h again
alex: noted, I'll be on next shift starting 08:00 UTC. thanks for the handoff
maya: closing PD page now; moving ongoing tasks to #incidents-postmortems. thanks team
incident-bot: Incident PD-2026-778 closed by maya at 2026-06-04T04:30:12Z :white_check_mark:
